# EducationMent

> EducationMent provides expert academic support for university students. Subject specialists write original work, entirely by humans, across 10+ disciplines, and run live 1:1 sessions. Students are served in the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, Dubai (UAE), New Zealand, Canada, Europe and India.

Key facts:

* 5,000+ students supported over the last 5 years
* 15,000+ projects completed
* More than 80% of work graded at distinction level
* 100% pass guarantee on every project
* Work is written by humans with no AI writing tools, and checked for originality
* Support on WhatsApp 24/7
* Work is provided as an expert model to support each student's own learning, in line with their university's academic integrity policy

## Services

* [Thesis & Dissertation Writing](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/thesis-dissertation-writing): Support for every chapter, from proposal to final submission.
* [Research Papers](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/research-papers): Rigorous papers built on credible, fully referenced sources.
* [Research Proposals](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/research-proposals): Proposals with clear aims and a sound methodology.
* [Case Studies](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/case-studies): Sharp analysis using the right frameworks.
* [Live Sessions](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/live-sessions): 1:1 video sessions with a subject expert.
* [Business Plans](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/business-plans): Plans with research, financials and strategy.
* [Annotated Bibliography](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/annotated-bibliography): Sources selected, evaluated and formatted.
* [Content Writing](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/content-writing): Essays, reports and academic content.
* [Presentations & Posters](https://educationment.vercel.app/services/presentations-posters): Designed decks and academic posters.
